messages:
Nina (CS): Quick heads-up  Alicia at Hightower AP just replied: they will not attach our DocuSign PDF to their PO because the envelope lists the parent entity. They want a short confirmation letter that includes the subscription pricing breakdown and the exact bill-to entity.
Carlos (AM): Which bill-to do they need?
Alicia (Customer Finance): Hightower US, Tax ID 23-4567890. Also need the 3-line pricing summary (base seats, overage estimate, support add-on) and the vendor code HTW-2026.
DocuSign Bot: Notice  envelope ID: 4c5f6a7b-0021-4d3f flagged for billing_entity mismatch.
Maya (Ops): If they only need a routing confirmation, Ops can produce a one-page "billing confirmation" PDF that references the signed Order Form and lists the line-item pricing. Do they require signature?
Alicia (Customer Finance): AP prefers a signed confirmation but will accept a completed stub with signer name/title and a scanned signature.
Leah (Legal): Keep the language narrow: "This billing confirmation is provided for procurement routing and does not modify the Order Form or Master Services Agreement." Add signer name/title/email and PO number placeholder. For records, Ops must upload the scanned doc to Box and link it to the customer file.
Carlos (AM): Timeline? Customer wants to issue PO by tomorrow EOD.
Maya (Ops): I can generate the stub now and email a PDF to ap@hightower.com. Will include vendor code HTW-2026, pricing lines, and a verification contact finance@redwood.com.
Nina (CS): Offer three options to Alicia: (A) we resend corrected DocuSign envelope with subsidiary metadata (if we can update quickly), (B) one-page signed PDF stub they attach to PO, (C) wet-signed scan they upload. Which is fastest for AP?
Alicia (Customer Finance): Option B. Please email PDF directly to ap@hightower.com.
Maya (Ops): Drafted and uploaded to Box: /Approvals/hightower/6132109876-billing-confirmation.pdf. DocSend: https://docsend.com/view/hightower-confirm-6132109876
Leah (Legal): I'll add the audit acceptance note to the customer record approving a scanned signature for this renewal (allowance under $200k).
Maya (Ops): Created ticket OPS-8110 to correct default billing entity for future envelopes so subsidiary shows in DocuSign metadata. Assigned to billing-ops.
DocuSign Bot: Recommendation  update metadata for envelope 4c5f6a7b-0021-4d3f to include "Hightower US".
Carlos (AM): Thanks team, I'll follow up on the PO tracker and jump on the 3pm call with Alicia if anything stalls.
Alicia (Customer Finance): Received PDF and attached to PO workflow. Will share PO# when available. :thumbsup:
Nina (CS): Marking this as resolved pending PO number. Reopen if AP rejects the attachment.
